CUDA-L2: Surpassing cuBLAS Performance for Matrix Multiplication through Reinforcement Learning





	
		
	
	
		🥳 Introduction
	

CUDA-L2 is a system that combines large language models (LLMs) and reinforcement learning (RL) to automatically optimize Half-precision General Matrix Multiply (HGEMM) CUDA kernels.
